response.sql: SELECT SUM(state_total) AS total_invoice_amount, AVG(invoice_count) AS average_invoices_per_state FROM (SELECT c.State, SUM(i.Total) AS state_total, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE CAST(i.InvoiceDate AS TEXT) > '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND CAST(i.InvoiceDate AS TEXT) < '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State) AS state_totals;
